$comment: The MCP servers modules can bring. Each entry says where it comes from: `install` (a command; it runs when a path in `output` is missing, and those paths go when no module needs the entry any more), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits). An entry with none of these is written by another entry's `install` (listed in its `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out. An entry may also give the server itself as `server` (merged into .mcp.json).

context7.describe: current library docs; `npx ctx7 setup` writes the server, its rule and its skill.
